construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written in this isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: schema_version=1; questions[{id,text}]; sources[{id,title,content, optional reliability (default 0.5), published (YYYY-MM-DD), origin (defaults to id), claims[{question_id,stance,quote}]}]; optional synthetic_fixture=false, min_sources=2, max_evidence=5
shared_schema.error: schema_version=1; status=error; error message; CLI exit 2
shared_schema.validation: One validate function for Python and CLI: strict fields, bounded nonempty strings and collections, unique IDs, valid dates, numeric ranges, known references, exact quoted evidence. CLI additionally rejects duplicate JSON fields and non-finite JSON constants.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single research stage: validated questions and supplied sources -> exact passage extraction -> relevance ranking -> origin-aware evidence aggregation -> decision-ready findings

behavior.retrieval: Explicit claims link verbatim passages to questions. Otherwise case-insensitive lexical overlap retrieves sentences with neutral stance.
behavior.ranking: 0.7 lexical relevance + 0.3 supplied reliability; deterministic tie-breaking
behavior.decision: Qualified reliability >= 0.5; conflicting qualified directions produce mixed; a single direction requires min_sources evidence origins; otherwise insufficient. All matches inform conclusions before presentation cap.
behavior.deduplication: Repeated passages within a source are deduplicated; shared origins or normalized duplicate full source texts do not independently corroborate.
behavior.caveats: Source annotations are not verified facts. Evidence strength describes corroboration, not probabilistic confidence. Dates are reported without freshness scoring.
behavior.cli: One UTF-8 JSON input file or '-' for stdin; one JSON object on stdout; success exit 0; file or validation failures exit 2.
behavior.fixture: Example sources are clearly labeled synthetic; no live provider or LLM step.

coverage: CLI file, parsing and usage errors
